title: TPO Code of Practice for Residential Estate Agents (England, Wales and NI)
key_point: Para 4b: asking/selling price advice must be in good faith, reflect market conditions and be supported by comparable evidence; 4c retain comparables.

title: Comparable evidence in real estate valuation (RICS professional standard)
key_point: Hierarchy: completed sales, then under-offer/STC, then asking prices (unreliable); adjust for location, condition, size, tenure, timing, energy efficiency.

title: Bargaining over Residential Real Estate: Evidence from England
publisher: CESifo WP 778 / Journal of Urban Economics 2004
key_point: London and South Yorkshire 1995-98: sale at ~96% of initial list price after ~11 weeks; >75% no list-price change; hot markets higher ratios.

title: Very Long-Run Discount Rates
key_point: English flats: 80-99yr leaseholds ~16% below freehold, 100-125yr ~10%, 125-150yr ~8%, 700+yr no discount.

title: The time value of housing: historical evidence on discount rates
publisher: Bank of England WP 621 / Economic Journal
key_point: Prime London 1987-92 leasehold sales show time-declining discount schedule; basis for lease relativity evidence.

title: People may be overpaying for lease extensions, says LSE research
key_point: About 8,000 Belgravia/Chelsea/Mayfair sales suggest tribunal relativity undervalues leases under 70 years, inflating extension premiums.

title: About the Price Paid Data
key_point: PPD gives price, date, type, new-build flag, tenure; no floor area or bedrooms; 2 weeks to 2 months registration lag.

title: The Rightmove House Price Index - The Facts
key_point: Average asking price of new listings (~90% of market), third Monday monthly, not seasonally adjusted; read alongside sold prices.

title: Analysis: What's in a house price index?
key_point: Rightmove mix-adjusted asking prices; Halifax/Nationwide mortgage-approval hedonic; LSL and ONS use Land Registry completions with lags.

title: Zoopla House Price Index September 2026
key_point: Achieved-price index; London -1% YoY, weakest region; only ~30% of London homes sell within three months vs ~75% Scotland.

title: Estate agents at odds over overvaluing to win instructions
key_point: GetAgent: 95% of agents saw rivals overvalue, 89% lost instructions to higher valuations, 67% say practice increasing.

title: Agents turn on rivals accused of unrealistic valuations
key_point: Agents recommend sellers judge agents on % of asking achieved (33%), track record (28%), time to sell (22%).

title: What estate agents should never do to win an instruction
key_point: Agent argues evidence-based pricing generates competition; buyers now see sold data; commenters say corporates chase stock for referral income.

title: Great expectations
key_point: Ombudsman: keep appraisal records, explain price reasoning in writing, refuse inflated instructions, review strategy in opening weeks.

title: Over-pricing increases time-to-sell by 26 days, says Rightmove
key_point: Correctly priced homes found buyers in 21 days vs 47 after cuts; 63% unreduced sold STC vs 32% reduced.

title: Estate agents are significantly over-pricing houses by up to £82,000
key_point: Property Solvers, 89,582 sales: asking-to-sale gap largest in SW London (£82k), NW London (£80k), West London (£59k).

title: Agents increasingly turning to high property valuations to win instructions
key_point: Agent Software reports rising overvaluation in a weak market; no quantified rates given.

title: Many homeowners 'get asking price wrong', says Zoopla
key_point: 78% misjudge value; only 16% of sellers whose home was worth less achieved asking; 74% cut price or accepted less.

title: Estate agents who overprice properties cost sellers £4.3bn
key_point: 370k sales: 19% cut 5%+; ~£20k lost each; 64 days longer; London 13% heavy cuts; online agents 13% vs 19%.

title: Selling a property? The priciest estate agents are most likely to overvalue
key_point: Top-10 overvaluing agents charge about double the commission of least overvaluing; a third of listings cut by average 6.9%.

title: How do estate agents value a property?
key_point: Appraisal weighs achieved prices, size, decor, features, extension potential, local changes; over-ambitious pricing usually lowers final price.

title: EPC data used to map London price per square foot
key_point: EPC floor area joined to Land Registry: London from under £300/sqft periphery to £1,000+ centre; EPC net area caveat.

title: Bedrooms, bathrooms and extensions: what adds value to your home in 2023?
key_point: Hedonic model: +10% floor area adds ~5%; extra bedroom 10-17%; bathroom ~6%; loft with bed+bath up to ~25%.

title: New build price premium rises to nearly a third
key_point: GB new-build premium ~30%; London exception with new builds ~10.5% below existing homes.

title: Executive Summary: The State of UK New Builds in Winter 2026
key_point: Snippet: London new-build premium 4.7%; new flats premium 61% vs houses 8.2% nationally; Outer London flats 24%.

title: Soaring service charges on leasehold flats hit capital values
key_point: Flats with service charge <=1% of value 50% more likely to sell than >=2%; London average £2,801/yr.

title: Landlords selling short-lease flats face tens of thousands in losses
key_point: Short-lease (<=60yr) flats listed 22.1% below average flat in England; London gap smallest at ~11%.

title: It's time to abolish Marriage Value
key_point: Below 80 years marriage value (50% of uplift) raises extension cost and depresses short-lease flat prices.

title: Had house valued today by 3 Estate Agents - 50K difference
key_point: Posters: agents inflate to win listing; choosing highest valuation led to long sales and final price below lowest valuation.

title: Lender valuation £20k below agents' valuations
key_point: Agents value what they can market; lender surveyors conservative; posters estimate agents ~15% above lender figures.

title: Property valuation
key_point: Agents give inflated 'marketing prices'; posters recommend RICS surveyor valuation and checking Rightmove competition before offering.

title: Disaster - HSBC have valued the flat at 20k under what I offered
key_point: Down-valuation traced to ~70-year lease; posters warn short lease blocks remortgage/resale, advise walking away.

title: Fraud: agents who deliberately over-value to win instructions act illegally
key_point: Headline only (403): deliberate overvaluation to win instructions argued to be illegal.

title: Should agents be held responsible for overvaluations?
key_point: Snippet: overvaluation already covered by consumer protection regulations; issue is professionalising the industry.

title: At A Glance: Prime central London price per square foot guide
key_point: Paywalled; snippet: Chelsea ~£1,182/sqft, Fulham ~£976/sqft Q2 2025; Chelsea premium over Fulham narrowed 47% to 21%.
